newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firm but general trend still down.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firm but general trend still down.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds firmed on Tuesday on correction and short-covering, in line with U.S. Treasuries, but dealers said on Tuesday the general trend was the opposite on fears of another U.S. interest rate hike.
"It is a calm day as there are no U.S. figures. Prices could be higher due to a correction or short-covering, and slightly stronger Treasuries," an ICFI Moscow Partners Bank dealer said.
U.S. statistics data usually affect the emerging markets. Many analysts expect a further interest rate hike from the Federal Open Market Committee Meeting in May.
Dealers said active buying was seen in the shortest maturity. They added local banks were more active buyers, though prices are currently edging down.
"The market is quiet today and the general trend is down as U.S. Treasuries are standing at low levels," one dealer said.
Dealers said the market is likely to liven up by the end of the week on U.S. jobless claims on Thursday and retail sales due on Friday.
